newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Jan-June mini vehicle sales down 4.1% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Jan-June mini vehicle sales down 4.1% yr/yr.

text.p: Japanese domestic sales of mini vehicles -- those with engines up to 660 cc -- fell 4.1 percent in the six months to June from a year earlier to 857,963 units, the Japan Mini Vehicle Association (JMVA) said on Friday.
Of that total, minicar sales in the January-June half year fell 3.5 percent from a year earlier to 493,713 and sales of mini commercial vehicles fell 5.0 percent to 364,250.

The steep rise in Honda's sales resulted from strong demand for its new Life multi-purpose vehicle, which was introduced on April 27, a JMVA official said.

Yachiyo Industry Co Ltd, owned 34.4 percent by Honda, produces Life model for Honda. Yachiyo had extra production for three days in June and plans to produce for two extra days in July. It has yet to decide production schedule in and after August, a Honda spokesman said.
